KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026 OUT: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has issued the KVS NVS 11 Phase Result for Tier 2 Exam for the post of TGT Hindi and PGT Hindi on 05 September on its official website i.e., cbse.gov.in. Those who are selected in the exam will be called to appear for an interview or a skill test as per the post. The marks are also released along with the result for posts that do not require an interview. The candidates can check direct result link, steps to check the result online, next step after the result, and other details through this article.

KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026 Out

The link to download the result is provided below. Applicants who appeared in the exam for teaching and non-teaching posts can check their KVS NVS Tier 2 result for Phase 1 to Phase 11 from the login window using their registration number and password. The subject-wise result link is also provided below for the candidates.

KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026 Direct Link: Click to Download

KVS NVS Tier 2 Result Latest Updates 2026

KVS NVS Phase 11 Tier 2 Result has been released on 05 September 2026 on ctet.nic.in

KVS NVS Tier 2 Result for Phase 1 to Phase 10 has already been released on the official website.

The results for posts without interview rounds are available along with the marks.

KVS NVS Tier 2 Marks 2026

KVS NVS Tier 2 Marks are available for the posts where there is no interview round. The marks are available in the candidate’s login portal along with the result declaration. For roles requiring an interview, this result indicates shortlisting status for the interview round. Full marksheets will be released within 15 days after the final result is published (following interview completion).

KVS NVS Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

The final answer key has been released on the official website along with the result on the website. Candidates can check the final answers through the provided link below for all the subjects.

KVS NVS Tier 2 Final Answer Key PDF

How to Check KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026?

The steps to download the KVS NVS Tier 2 Result from the official website of CBSE are given below:

Step 1. Go to the official website of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) i.e., www.cbse.gov.in.

Step 2. Click on the ‘Live Link’ given under the phase-wise result under the ‘Latest Update’ section

Step 3. A new page will open, i.e., examinationservices.nic.in

Step 4. Please enter your Registration No and Password’ to access your account and complete the registration process.

Step 5: Check the KVS Tier 2 Result and NVS Tier 2 Result

Step 6: Take a printout of the result.

Details Mentioned on KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026

All the selected candidates can find the following details in their KVS NVS Tier 2 Result PDF. They are advised to check all the information mentioned in the result to avoid any mistakes.

  • Name of the exam
  • Advertisement Number
  • Applied post name like Teaching or Non-Teaching
  • Candidate roll number or application number
  • Candidate category
  • Status for selection to the next stage
  • Important instructions for the shortlisted candidate

What if I Forget KVS NVS Application Number?

If you forget your KVS or NVS application number, you can easily get it back from the official website. The simple steps to get your application number are given below:

  1. Visit the official website of NVS or KVS.
  2. Open the candidate login page.
  3. Click on “Forgot Registration Number”.
  4. Enter your name, date of birth, and parents’ names.
  5. Your application number will be sent to your registered email or mobile number.
  6. You can also check old emails or messages from NVS/KVS for your registration details.

What’s Next After KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026?

Selected candidates in Tier 2 will be called for an interview or skill test round. The selection process consists of:

  • For Teaching Posts (PGT/TGT/PRT): The final merit list will be done on the basis of 85% weightage from the Tier 2 and 15% from the interview and demo lesson.
  • For Non-Teaching Posts (Stenographer/JSA): Selection will mainly be based on Tier 2 performance. However, the candidates will also need to qualify in the skill test, such as the typing or computer proficiency test.

KVS NVS Skill Test/ Interview Admit Card 2026

The date and time for call letters for interviews or skill tests will be uploaded to candidate logins once finalised in consultation with KVS/NVS. Students are required to login into the official website to download their call letters. Preference Submission: Candidates required to submit post/location preferences must do so carefully through the portal within the stipulated timeframe.

Preference Submission

Candidates required to submit post/location preferences must do so carefully through the portal within the stipulated timeframe.

KVS NVS Qualifying Marks 2026

The qualifying marks are the minimum scores candidates are expected to secure in Tier 2 to remain in consideration for the next stage. The expected post-wise qualifying marks for KVS NVS Tier 2 are given below:

Category PGT (Out of 150) TGT (Out of 150) PRT (Out of 180)
General / UR 107–113 91–97 132–138
OBC (NCL) 102–107 85–90 125–130
EWS 103–108 83–88 125–128
SC 93–98 73–78 115–120
ST 86–91 67–71 105–112

KVS NVS Tier 2 Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: What is KVS NVS Tier 2 Result Link 2026 ?

Answer: The result is available on the official website of the Central Board of Secondary Education i.e. cbse.gov.in and the Examination Service Authority i.e. examinationservices.nic.in/ 

Ques: What is KVS NVS 11th Phase Result Date ?

Answer: KVS NVS Tier 2 result for Phase 11 is announced on 05 September 2026.

Ques: How to download KVS NVS Tier 2 Result ?

Answer: The candidates can download the result using the following details:

  • Registration number 
  • Password

Ques: What is KVS NVS PRT Tier 2 Result Date ?

Answer: The result for KVS NVS PRT Tier 2 will be available anytime soon on the official website of CBSE.

Ques: What is KVS NVS Interview Date ?

Answer: The interview details will be available in due course of time
